mode: P4 closeout mixed: prefill bf16 weights, decode dequantized fp8 weights (incl. lm_head)

quant.format: fp8 e4m3 (1s + 4e bias7 + 3m, max finite 448, no inf)
quant.granularity: per output row of [N,K]: one fp32 scale per row

lm_head.native_effect: fp8 pack lm_head dtype=2 -> loader fills fp8_lm_head/scale_lm_head -> decode (M=1) lm_head on gemv_fp8; prefill (M>1) lm_head stays BF16; MC_FP8_LMHEAD_OFF=1 reverts decode to BF16
